question: How is the Shiva-bindu described in relation to the letter ma?
premises: Scripture speaks of this as the bindu.
It is regarded as the Shiva-bindu.
It is distinct from the letter ma and bears only its shadow.
inference: The Shiva-bindu is taught in scripture as distinct from ma, holding only a trace of it.
plain_english: In scripture this is spoken of as the bindu and is regarded as the Shiva-bindu. It is indeed other than the letter ma, bearing only its shadow.
